minutes_text:
Arts Commission

  Inglewood, California
  May 17, 2023

A meeting of the Inglewood Arts Commission was convened on May 17, 2023.
Commissioner Metcalf called the meeting to order at 6:30 p.m. followed by the flag salute.

Stephanie Maldonado announced the presence of a quorum as follows:

  Present:  Commissioner Aletha Metcalf ‐ District 1, Commissioner Olivia Alvitre
  - District 2, Commissioner Phyllis Battle - District 3, Commissioner
  Jacques Lesure - Commissioner at Large

  Absent:  Commissioner Vicki Perryman-Banks - District 4

City Personnel present were as follows:

  Sabrina Barnes  Parks, Recreation, and Community Services Director
  Helen Lessick  Public Art Consultant
  Stephanie Maldonado  Senior Management Assistant

PUBLIC COMMENTS. None

MINUTES. None

STAFF REPORT. ITC Lead Artists: Semi-finalist Contracts. Staff report recommending the
Arts Commission receive and file the recommendations of the Inglewood Transit
Connector Lear Artists Ned Kahn, Norie Sato, and Vicki Scuri as semi-finalists to be
contracted in the amount of $10,000 each to develop individual Methods of Approach to
the public art planning opportunity. The panel recommended artist Susan Narduli as an
alternate, ensuring three semi-finalists.

VERBAL REPORTS. Public Art‐Related Projects.
  1. IGAP 2023 Project Update: Public Art Concert Curator RFP developed; internal
  review of work in progress; Percent for Art ordinance precludes funding
  performances; Revisiting internal discussion to modify the ordinance to allow a
  small percentage of the Public Art Fund for performed art.
  2. Public Art 2023: Utility Box Vinyl Wrapping Timeline: April 21, 2023 ‐ RFP issued to
  invited arts organizations; May 15, 2023 ‐ Deadline for questions to City Public Art;

  1
   Arts Commission

  May 22, 2023 ‐ Deadline for organizations to submit proposals by 5 p.m.; Week of
  May 24 ‐ Proposal Review and Ranking Finalist and Alternate; June ‐ Contracting
  Art Organization for Creative Services; July 2023 ‐ Contracted services Notice to
  Proceed – organization identifies artists.

PUBLIC REMARKS. None

COMMISSIONERS’ COMMENTS/INITIATIVES/ART CALENDAR. None

There being no further business to be presented, Commissioner Metcalf declared the
meeting adjourned, at 7:16 p.m.
